notablePrerequisites:
Nim Deathmantle attached to Elenda.
Elenda has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {1}.
Elenda dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing three Vampire tokens, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying {4} to return Elenda to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {1}.
Elenda triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {1}.
Elenda dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Vampire tokens, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 5.
